We offer a 30-day return policy for all unused items in original packaging.

  • Items must be in original condition
  • Include receipt or order confirmation
  • Refund processed within 5-7 business days

Visit our returns page to start a return.
Standard shipping takes 3-7 business days within the continental US. Expedited shipping (1-2 business days) is available for an additional fee. Free shipping on orders over $50.
Yes, we ship to over 50 countries worldwide. International shipping typically takes 7-14 business days. Customs duties and taxes are the responsibility of the recipient.
